# Add Music Up Next

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Adds the provided music to the up next queue.

## Syntax

~~~~text
addUpNext(music: <#Variable#>, place: <#Enumeration (WFWhenToPlay) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
addUpNext(music: ShortcutInput, place: Next)
~~~~
